remarks:
Welcome home to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence nestled in an adorable, quiet neighborhood. Conveniently located within walking distance of the elementary school and local convenience store, this home offers both comfort and convenience.

Inside, you'll find a spacious living and dining area that's perfect for everyday living or entertaining. The former sunroom has been thoughtfully converted into a bright laundry room, offering plenty of space to fold laundry while enjoying the natural sunlight—making household chores a little more enjoyable. Ample closet space throughout the home provides excellent storage for all your needs.

Outside, you'll love the quaint backyard, perfect for relaxing, gardening, or spending time with family and friends. This home has been well cared for and features numerous updates, including a brand-new front porch, new roof, new furnace, new hot water tank, and many additional upgrades throughout.

Whether you're house shopping for the first time, looking to downsize, or searching for the perfect place to call home, this move-in-ready gem has everything you need. Don't miss the opportunity to make this wonderful home yours!
